candidateObservations.author: @kelseyinlondon
candidateObservations.caption: ad 🇪🇬 Welcome to Sharm El-Sheikh, Egypt ⬇️ @Experience Egypt Official   This is what winter looks like in Egypt ☀️🐠🌅🏝️ I recently visited Sharm El-Sheikh for some winter sun, where I experienced warm 25-degree days, turquoise seas, ancient worlds and desert adventures. I highly recommend visiting during Ramadan, which meant every street was lined with lanterns and lively celebrations each evening.  Here are my top recommendations on things to do in Sharm El-Sheikh:  1. Ras Mohammed National Park – A must for snorkelling or diving, with crystal-clear water, beautiful coral reefs and some of the most colourful marine life in the Red Sea. 2. Al-Sahaba Mosque –An architectural showstopper in the Old Market, especially beautiful at night when it’s illuminated against the desert sky. 3. Desert Safari Experience – Head into the Sinai Desert by quad or 4x4, ride across golden dunes and end with a Bedouin dinner under the stars. 4. Farsha Cafe – A cliffside spot overlooking the sea, famous for its boho décor, sunset views and evening light shows. 5. Al Mustafa Mosque – One of the city’s largest mosques, known for its grand domes and peaceful setting, particularly stunning at sunset. 6. Del Mar Beach Lounge – A relaxed beachfront hangout with sun loungers, cocktails and clear water perfect for swimming and snorkelling. 7. SOHO Square – A lively entertainment hub with restaurants, shops, a year-round ice rink and evening shows all in one place. 8. Old Market – The heart of local life, packed with spice stalls, souvenirs, street food and traditional cafés.  #ExperienceEgypt #VisitEgypt 🇪🇬 Places to visit in Egypt itinerary. Egypt travel guide. candidateObservations.author: @itstherespawn
candidateObservations.caption: Spirit Halloween's Freddy Fazbear animatronic just had its first real-world debut, showing up on a dedicated stage at the retailer's flagship store. The full-scale prop went viral after fans saw the $500 animatronic performing in stores for the first time.  Freddy stands on a stage styled after Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, complete with red curtains, a brick backdrop, and an illuminated Five Nights at Freddy's sign, and fans can trigger his performance using a paw-print step pad, which makes him wave, raise his mic, and sway while his eyes light up and games audio plays.  At $499.99, he's priced as one of Spirit Halloween's most expensive props for the 2026 season. Reaction has been mixed, with some fans excited to own a full-size Freddy and others questioning whether an audible squeak in his movements is acceptable at that price. There's no dedicated product page live yet, but the animatronic is expected to be available throughout Spirit Halloween's 2026 season. #fnaf #gaming #freddyfazbear #fivenightsatfreddys
